feedback: Please revise the mapping before approval. Restrict current legal-name claims to records supported as current by the publisher's current-name indicators, or explicitly use the supported current-name field without emitting historical names as current. Do not emit an ARBN as entity.acn: use the documented Type qualifier to exclude that case. Do not equate external administration with liquidation unless the publisher evidence establishes that exact meaning; otherwise map it to unknown or leave it unmapped. Encode these protections in the declarative config, not only in limitations. Keep the existing reader and partitions unchanged.
